context_precision_leaf.note: exact leaf-node hits over retrieved leaf nodes. Ancestry-expanded paragraph ids are NOT in the denominator: a paragraph that contains a required sentence is not itself a retrieved leaf.

interpretation_rule: A gap below the registered MMD is a NULL RESULT and must never be reported as a win. MMD is a property of the split, not a tunable.

latency.caveat: DESKTOP CPU measurements, threads=1 for the model path, on a shared host. Not an Android or on-device figure. Contention noise is present when concurrent jobs were running; compare systems only under equal load.

notes: 4 of 59 items were EXCLUDED from the survival denominators because no required atom had a retrievable host paragraph in this tier. They are listed in per_item with excluded=..., not silently counted as misses.

storage.index_payload_basis: MEASURED buffer sizes of the packed postings arrays, plus any on-disk .npy embedding caches. Excludes Python object overhead; peak RSS is the process-level figure and is reported separately.
storage.never_summed: index_payload_bytes and weights_bytes are reported separately and MUST NOT be added into a single 'size' figure: the index ships beside the app, the weights ARE the app, and a mobile claim needs them apart.
storage.shared_generator_note: IDENTICAL for every architecture and therefore EXCLUDED from per-system cost, per experiments/baselines/HYPOTHESIS.md section 9. Listed so a reader can add it back deliberately rather than by accident.
storage.weights_basis: MEASURED os.path.getsize of cached safetensors + tokenizer
